verdict.rationale: Codex offers a diff/summary review step (codex-docs-5) and can run multiple tasks in parallel in isolated cloud environments (codex-docs-1, codex-docs-3), and community mentions a native 'Codex App' desktop client (codex-comm-2, codex-comm-9, codex-comm-18). However, the desktop app appears macOS-only (codex-comm-11, codex-comm-20) with usability rough edges ('paper cuts', stuck loading screens), and no evidence explicitly confirms a side-by-side multi-session UI within the desktop app itself.
